subject: Biologie
scopeLimit: Independent content recheck of the revised RNAi P-v2 profile only. This does not certify learner performance, human approval, the other Q1 profiles, central five-gate completion or M7.

primarySources.scope: Ausgabe 2024, Stand 01.08.2025, Q1.2 Leistungskurs RNA-Interferenz, printed page 39
Primary biochemical study of Ago2, siRNA guide strand, sequence-specific target-mRNA cleavage

technicalCheck.interpretation: Current structural binding for the three configured profiles; this review assesses RNAi content separately.

resolvedPreviousFinding: The second case now asks the learner to explain a new matching siRNA on an altered target, with both target-mRNA and protein decreases measured against untreated and previously matching but now nonmatching comparisons. It supplies a second positive RNAi explanation rather than only a negative control.
contentFindings: The two cases vary the target context and sequence match. Case 1 uses a supplied Ago2/guide-strand schema; case 2 transfers the principle to an altered mRNA and newly designed matching siRNA. Both require a learner explanation, so the two-demonstration claim is supportable.

The DE and EN tasks, expected performances and understanding focuses ask for the same sequence-dependent interpretation and the same measured mRNA/protein comparison. Neither asks for DNA alteration, a universal RNAi route, a therapy outcome or guaranteed effects in other cells.

The 42% target-mRNA and 45% protein values in case 2 are consistent with reduced mRNA availability and protein formation. They do not by themselves prove Ago2 cleavage or exclude other causes; the wording correctly asks for a possible RNAi pathway and says the control values support, rather than prove, sequence dependence. Translational repression alone would not explain the lower measured mRNA, so assessment of a learner response should require that readout to be addressed.

The active 1672x941 PNG was visually inspected at original size. It depicts the first siRNA/RISC cleavage example and does not claim to depict the second case or all RNAi mechanisms. Canonical, public and backend PNG copies are byte-identical at the bound hash; machine image QA is yes and human approval remains no.
sourceScopeDecision: The current Hessian Q1.2 source names RNA interference at LK level. The revised profile remains a supplied siRNA example within the narrower current DE/EN canonical goal; the raw DE-BY applicability is not independently established by this source check.
